title: Lifestyle Product Photos for Ecommerce | AIVideosUGC
description: Create a lifestyle product photo from one plain product image by choosing a table, room or café setting for your online shop or social feed.
h1: Lifestyle Product Photos for Product Pages and Social Posts
lead: Put your product on a breakfast table, a reading corner or a café counter, starting from one plain product photo. No props, no photoshoot.
secondary_keywords: product in a home setting photo

steps.d: Whole product in frame and in focus. A plain background works best.
One place, one surface, the light and a prop or two, like "marble café table, morning sun, a cappuccino".
If the scene feels busy, ask for fewer props and compare.

faq.q: Can I choose where the product sits in the scene?
faq.a: Name the surface, the product’s position and one or two props; for example, a handbag on a marble café table beside a cappuccino.

faq.q: Can a lifestyle image replace a product listing photo?
faq.a: Keep a plain product view available for shoppers who need to see the item, its closures and dimensions without a styled setting.

faq.q: What lifestyle scenes work for home goods?
faq.a: A bedside table, calm shelf or kitchen counter gives a lamp, pillow or serving dish a recognizable place in the home.

faq.q: Can I use lifestyle photos in Facebook or Instagram posts?
faq.a: Yes. Add your caption and link in the post, and put any price or offer in your ad editor.

overview.d: Create a lifestyle product photo from a plain image by naming one setting. A breakfast table, reading corner or café counter gives the item a place in a buyer’s routine. Name one surface, the light and a prop or two so the scene stays focused on the product.

examples.lead: See a handbag, planter, hoodie, mug or linen product placed in a recognizable everyday setting.

limitations.h2: What a lifestyle scene can show

items.d: Use a familiar surface or room to show where the item might sit or be used.
Add verified size and measurements to your listing.
Generated light and styling can change the appearance of hardware or color.

steps.prompt: Put this tan leather handbag on a marble café table next to a cappuccino, keeping the handle and gold clasp exactly as they are.

picker.title: Choose a lifestyle scene by product type
picker.lead: Pick a table, room or outdoor setting that fits an item in your shop.

cards.label: Planter beside a sofa
cards.prompt: Place the planter by a linen sofa in soft window light, keeping its rim and full outline clear.

cards.label: Pillowcase on an unmade bed
cards.prompt: Set the product on relaxed linen bedding with gentle morning light and uncluttered surroundings.

cards.label: Snack bag with fresh fruit
cards.prompt: Arrange the package beside fresh fruit on a calm kitchen surface, leaving the front easy to read.

cards.label: Sauce jar beside dinner
cards.prompt: Place the jar near a finished pasta dish on a warm kitchen table and keep its label visible.

cards.label: Suede loafers by the door
cards.prompt: Set both loafers on a quiet entryway floor with their stitching and full shape visible.

cards.label: Silk scarf on a handbag
cards.prompt: Tie the scarf on a simple handbag handle with soft light and enough space to see its pattern.

cards.label: Hiking boot above a lake
cards.prompt: Show the boot on a mossy rock above a distant lake, keeping its laces and sole clear.

cards.label: Market tote with produce
cards.prompt: Place the tote at a farmers market stall with a few fresh items and its handles visible.

uses.d: After the white-background shot, a scene shows the size and where the product belongs.
A product in a real setting gets noticed faster than a cut-out. Put the caption and link in the post.

input.good_label: Whole storage set, shelf in view
input.bad_label: Storage set cut off at the frame edge

input.good_label: Tea pouch and label stay sharp
input.bad_label: Pouch details lost in soft focus

items: Write your caption and link in the post, not on the image.
Check hardware, stitching and color against your product.
Make a second setting for another season or audience.
